title: Small business adds a vendor and pays by ACH/check (card-funded optional) with Pro approval

moments.customer_action: Confirm and pay. moments.frontstage: Check payments show 'Debited' ('We've withdrawn from your U.S. Bank account'), 'Outstanding' ('We've mailed the check, but the vendor hasn't cashed it') or 'Cleared' ('The vendor has cashed the check'). Payment notifications are still not documented.

moments.action: Approver declines a held payment, or the vendor says the payment never arrived
moments.frontstage: Decline: Approvals tab > select payment > 'More options' > 'Decline'; 'You'll receive a confirmation screen once completed' (S972). Non-receipt: bank guarantees delivery by the selected date when funds are sufficient, details correct and the payment was scheduled to arrive by the due date; 'If your vendor has not received your payment and it's after the payment date, let us know' (800-236-7700); schedule at least five business days ahead for checks (S989). Returned ACH to vendors is still not documented.

exceptions.customer_experience: Level 1/2 approver opens Approvals tab, selects the payment, chooses More options > Decline and sees a confirmation screen

exceptions.trigger: Level 3 user schedules a payment above the Level-1-set Payment limit (Pro plan)
exceptions.customer_experience: Payment is held pending review; Level 1 or Level 2 user reviews and approves
exceptions.bank_handling: Approval queue inside bill pay for business; limit configured per user under Settings > Users and roles
exceptions.resolution: Approved payments proceed; declined/expired approval handling not documented

exceptions.customer_experience: Customer checks check status (Debited / Outstanding / Cleared) and calls 800-236-7700 after the payment date
exceptions.bank_handling: On-time delivery guarantee when funds were sufficient, details correct and the payment was scheduled to arrive by the due date
exceptions.resolution: Bank investigates; edit/cancel possible only until the payment is debited

assessment: Modern embedded AP (bill capture, email inbox, card-funded vendor pay, approvals) launched 2025; notification and exception documentation is thin.
